package.description: Download a GitHub Pull Request patch and split it into per-commit patch files.

en-US.description: Download a GitHub Pull Request patch and split it into per-commit patch files.
en-US.longDescription:
patchsplit is a Rust command-line tool that downloads a GitHub Pull Request
.patch file and splits it into one patch file per commit.

Since v1.1.0, pass `-s` / `--squash` to also write the PR's net diff as a
single patch.
en-US.name: patchsplit
